angle: Rather than deriving backprop calculus, this video narrates it as per-example wishes flowing backward layer by layer (bright connections matter most, in a loose Hebbian flavor) and averaging into the gradient, closing with the mini-batch shortcut.
angle_detail: Focus on [03:39]-[09:14], where one image of a 2 votes on output nudges, weights, prior activations and their backward averaging; then take [09:33]-[10:35] for mini-batches and stochastic gradient descent. No number is ever computed for any weight, so treat the sensitivity story as qualitative and pair it with a calculus source for exam derivations. The Hebbian analogy is flagged in-video as loose, and the closing MNIST data plea is context, not examinable method.
